# AgenticServiceOrchestration

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A service-oriented architecture pattern where autonomous AI agents dynamically compose, negotiate, and execute distributed services without centralized control. Enables adaptive, self-organizing service workflows that can be mapped onto topology-centric computing fabrics for real-time resource allocation.
